hearth.law.hud.suspected: The guards of %s have their eye on you
hearth.law.notice_posted: No guard could be spared to come for you. The watch of %s posts your bounty, %s bits: every guard will know your face.
hearth.law.wanted_now: Word has reached the guard of %s: you are wanted for %s. Bounty: %s bits.
hearth.law.locked: Locked (%s). You need the key, or a lockpick in hand.
hearth.law.trespass.warned: You are not welcome here at this hour.
hearth.law.paid: You paid %s into the treasury of %s. The matter is settled.
hearth.law.confiscated: The guard takes %s stolen things from you.
hearth.law.reprimand: With no cell to put you in, the guard of %s gives you a public dressing-down. People will talk.
hearth.law.jail.start: You are locked in the cell of %2$s for %1$s minutes. Walking out is a crime of its own.
hearth.law.jail.done: Your time is served. The jailer of %s lets you go.
hearth.law.jail.slept: You sleep off %s hours in the cell of %s and are let go, stiff and hungry.
hearth.law.jail.escaped: You have broken out of the cell of %s. The bounty is back on your head.
hearth.law.pillory.start: You are put in the pillory of %2$s for %1$s minutes. The whole town can see you.
hearth.law.pillory.done: They let you out of the pillory of %s. Folk will remember.
hearth.law.lockpick.title: Picking a lock
hearth.law.lockpick.help: Move the mouse to work the pick round the keyhole
hearth.law.lockpick.help2: Hold left mouse, D or Space to turn · Esc to stop
hearth.law.pocket.title: Pockets of %s
hearth.law.pocket.help: Click to lift · click again to let go · Esc to slip away
hearth.law.pocket.caught: %s caught your hand in their pocket!
hearth.law.choice.persuade: Talk my way out of it (%s%%)
hearth.law.choice.refuse_hard: Refuse (they will take it as resisting)
hearth.law.choice.threaten: Keep your mouth shut, or else (%s%%)
hearth.law.guard.halt: Stop right there. You're wanted for %s. That's %s bits, or you come with me.
hearth.law.guard.murder: Murderer! %s, you'll answer for the blood on your hands.
hearth.law.guard.search: Hold it. Folk say things have gone missing since you came to town. Empty your pockets.
hearth.law.guard.settled: That's that, then. Keep out of trouble.
hearth.law.guard.bribed: I never saw you. Go on, get out of my sight.
hearth.law.guard.reduced: Fine. Half, then: %s bits. Don't push your luck.
hearth.law.guard.persuade_failed: Nice try. That'll be %s bits now.
hearth.law.guard.bribe_failed: Are you trying to bribe an officer of the law? %s bits, and count yourself lucky.
hearth.law.guard.resist: So that's how it is. To arms!
hearth.law.guard.found: Well, well. And whose is this? That's %s bits you owe now.
hearth.law.guard.watching: Suit yourself. I've got my eye on you.
hearth.law.witness.confront: I saw what you did! You've got some nerve. What have you got to say for yourself?
hearth.law.witness.bribed: ...I didn't see anything. Nothing at all.
hearth.law.witness.cowed: Alright! Alright. I'll keep quiet. Please.
hearth.law.witness.refused: Keep your coin. The guard will hear of this!
hearth.law.say.witness.murder: Murder! Murder! Somebody fetch the guard!
hearth.law.say.witness.trespass: What are you doing in here?
hearth.law.say.get_out: Get out of here, or I'll call the guard!
hearth.law.say.jeer.3: Not so clever now, are we?
hearth.law.talk.pay: I'd like to pay my fine (%s).
hearth.law.talk.fence: I've some goods that need a new home...
hearth.law.fence.sold: The fence takes %s things off your hands for %s. No questions asked.
hearth.law.fence.broke: Not today, friend. I've no coin left for that sort of thing.
hearth.law.command.no_settlement: You are not in a settlement.
hearth.law.command.clean: No warrants, no suspicion. Clean as a whistle.
hearth.law.command.look_at_lock: Look at a door or a chest.
